# Scenario 2: Idempotency and Zero-Disk execution
# This test verifies that consecutive runs with no changes in Git
# do not recreate containers or generate unnecessary disk writes.

# Step 1: Initialize local Git repo
cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: initial setup'
cd ..

# Step 2: Prepare configuration with absolute path
cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# Step 3: First deployment cycle
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

# Step 4: Second deployment cycle (absolutely no changes in Git)
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

# Step 5: Verify idempotency
# Ensure the proxy and app containers were NOT restarted or mutated
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1


# --- FILE TEMPLATES ---

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
